sections.heading: Subject Matter Insured
sections.body: Road construction materials, consumables and equipment belonging to the Insured or held in trust, including bitumen in drums and tankers, emulsions, TMT steel, cement in bags, aggregates handling attachments, spare parts of hot mix plants, pavers, rollers and allied machinery, while in transit within India by road and rail between suppliers, depots, batching plants and project sites of the Insured.

sections.heading: Scope of Cover
sections.body: Inland Transit Clauses (A) - All Risks, extended to cover Strikes, Riots and Civil Commotion as per Inland Transit (Rail/Road) SRCC Clauses. Cover attaches from the time the goods leave the warehouse or premises at the place named for commencement of transit and continues during the ordinary course of transit until delivered to the final destination named in the declaration. Transit of over-dimensional cargo requires prior intimation to the Insurer.

sections.heading: Declaration and Adjustment
sections.body: The Insured shall declare every despatch on a monthly basis by the 10th of the following month, stating invoice number, description of goods, mode of conveyance and invoice value. The premium charged is a deposit premium and shall be adjusted at expiry on the basis of actual declared turnover at the agreed rate, subject to retention of a minimum premium of 75 percent of the deposit premium.

sections.heading: Important Conditions and Exclusions
sections.body: Each and every claim is subject to an excess of 1 percent of the value of the consignment, minimum INR 10,000.00. Excluded: wilful misconduct, ordinary leakage and loss in weight, insufficient packing, inherent vice, delay, insolvency of carriers, and loss arising from unroadworthiness of the conveyance known to the Insured. Goods transported in vehicles owned by the Insured are covered only if driven by a duly licensed driver.

sections.heading: Claims Procedure
sections.body: In the event of loss or damage, notify the Insurer's Pune Marine Claims Cell immediately at 1800-209-4417 or marineclaims@sahyadrigeneral.example.in, lodge a monetary claim on the carrier within the statutory period, preserve the damaged goods for survey, and submit invoice, lorry receipt or railway receipt, survey report and carrier's acknowledgement. Rights of recovery against carriers must not be waived.

sections.heading: Grievance Redressal
sections.body: For any grievance, contact the Grievance Officer at grievance@sahyadrigeneral.example.in. If not resolved within 15 days, the Insured may approach the IRDAI Bima Bharosa portal or the Insurance Ombudsman, Pune. This policy is issued subject to receipt of premium in advance as per Section 64VB of the Insurance Act, 1938. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation.
